name: Prospector
text: When an action gains you gold, +1 gold.

name: Impressionist
text: Whenever you copy an action, +1 of its color.

name: Bargain Bin
text: Whenever shop members go to the bottom of the pile, +1 blue.

name: Pocket Watch
text: Whenever a player’s turn is skipped, +1 purple.

name: Caterer
text: Whenever you give a rival something, +1 silver.

name: Farmer
text: Whenever an action gains you yellow, +1 yellow.

name: Money Changer
text: Whenever you turn resources or members into followers, +1 white.
